page: Microsoft Azure EC96as_v6 is an ECasv6-family virtual machine configured with 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 AMD processor architecture. The system is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 672.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 7.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, but it is designated as Premium Storage capable for external block storage attachments.

With dedicated CPU allocation and a high memory-to-core ratio, this server type is designed for memory-intensive workloads. The absence of local storage means all data persistence relies on network-attached Premium Storage. It is suited for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines that require consistent compute performance without GPU acceleration.
